## devonthink
CRITICAL — Database package safety: DEVONthink databases are stored as packages (.dtBase2) or sparse images (.dtSparse, .dtArchive). Never modify, rename, move, or delete files inside a database package directly via the filesystem. All record and content operations must go through this MCP server or, as a fallback, via AppleScript. Direct filesystem manipulation will corrupt the database and cause irreversible data loss.

Batch operations: Use the uuids array parameter instead of sequential single-record calls for tag, update, move, trash, duplicate, replicate, and export operations. Batch mode is faster, reduces round trips, and returns a summary with succeeded/failed counts.

Avoiding duplicates: Use lookup_records (by name, URL, path, filename, or comment) before create_record to check whether a record already exists.

Content editing: Prefer update_record_content with mode append or insert over replace for large documents. Replace mode requires sending the entire new content and risks accidental data loss if the content is incomplete.

Group hierarchies: Use create_group_path to create nested group structures in a single call (like mkdir -p) rather than sequential create_record calls.

AI-powered tools: classify_record and find_similar_records use DEVONthink's built-in AI algorithms and proprietary training data — they provide organizational suggestions that complement, not duplicate, your own capabilities.

Record enrichment: resolve_doi_metadata and resolve_book_metadata can enrich existing records with bibliographic metadata by passing the record's uuid — there is no need to create a new record.

AI exclusion: Records marked as excluded from AI access (excludeFromChat) are protected in two ways. (1) Input protection: any tool that receives such a record's UUID as an argument refuses to operate on it and returns an error. (2) Output protection: result lists from tools like search_records, classify_record, find_similar_records, get_record_children, get_record_duplicates, and the link traversal tools are filt… [truncated]

Also use when the user mentions "CLAUDE.md maintenance" or "project memory optimization".
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. - Refuses to create a file if the email already exists anywhere in `client/`, `colleagues/`, or `friends/`, printing the existing path instead — matching the "if a contact already has a file, update it in place" rule in CLAUDE.md

// Creates a new contact markdown file from template.md for a brand-new
// contact (e.g. one discovered via a Gmail label with no existing file — see
// "Full Repo Access" / "Gmail Labels for Category Routing" in CLAUDE.md).
// gmail-sync only updates contacts that already have a file; this script is
// the manual step that creates one.
import * as fs from "node:fs";
import * as path from "node:path";

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const TEMPLATE_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "template.md");

const CATEGORY_DIRS: Record<string, string> = {
  client: "client",
  colleague: "colleagues",
  friend: "friends",
};

function slugify(s: string): string {
  return s
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "") // strip accents
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}

function makeFilename(
  lastName: string,
  firstName: string,
  email: string,
  usedFilenames: Set<string>
): string {
  let base: string;
  if (lastName && firstName) {
    base = slugify(`${lastName}-${firstName}`);
  } else if (lastName) {
    base = slugify(lastName);
  } else if (firstName) {
    base = slugify(firstName);
  } else {
    base = slugify(email.split("@")[0]);
  }
  if (!base) base = slugify(email.replace("@", "-at-"));

  let filename = base;
  if (usedFilenames.has(filename)) {
    const domain = email.split("@")[1]?.split(".")[0] || "dup";
    filename = `${base}-${slugify(domain)}`;
  }
  let final = filename;
  let counter = 2;
  while (usedFilenames.has(final)) {
    final = `${filename}-${counter}`;
    counter++;
  }
  return `${final}.md`;
}

function findExistingContact(email: string): string | null {
  const needle = email.toLowerCase();
  for (const dir of ["client", "colleagues", "friends"]) {
    const abs = path.join(ROOT, dir);
    if (!fs.existsSync(abs)) continue;
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(abs)) {
      if (!f.endsWith(".md")) continue;
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(abs, f), "utf-8").toLowerCase();
      if (raw.includes(needle)) return `${dir}/${f}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function parseArgs(argv: string[]) {
  let name = "";
  let category = "";
  const emails: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const a = argv[i];
    if (a === "--name") name = argv[++i] ?? "";
    else if (a === "--email") emails.push((argv[++i] ?? "").trim());
    else if (a === "--category") category = argv[++i] ?? "";
  }
  return { name: name.trim(), category: category.trim(), emails: emails.filter(Boolean) };
}

function buildFrontmatter(
  lastName: string,
  firstName: string,
  emails: string[],
  today: string
): string {
  const lines = ["---"];
  lines.push(`last_name: ${lastName}`);
  lines.push(`first_name: ${firstName}`);
  if (emails.length > 1) {
    lines.push("emails:");
    for (const e of emails) lines.push(`  - "${e}"`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`email: "${emails[0]}"`);
  }
  lines.push(`last_updated: ${today}`);
  lines.push("---");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function main() {
  const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (argv.includes("--help") || argv.length === 0) {
    console.error(
      "Usage: npm run create-contact -- --name \"First Last\" --email a@b.com [--email c@d.com ...] --category client|colleague|friend\n" +
        "Creates a new contact file from template.md. Refuses if the email already exists in another contact file."
    );
    process.exit(argv.length === 0 ? 1 : 0);
  }

  const { name, category, emails } = parseArgs(argv);

  if (!CATEGORY_DIRS[category]) {
    console.error(`--category must be one of: ${Object.keys(CATEGORY_DIRS).join(", ")}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (emails.length === 0) {
    console.error("At least one --email is required.");
    process.exit(1);
  }
  for (const e of emails) {
    if (!e.includes("@")) {
      console.error(`Not a valid email address: ${e}`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }

  for (const e of emails) {
    const existing = findExistingContact(e);
    if (existing) {
      console.error(`⚠️  ${e} already appears in ${existing} — not creating a duplicate.`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }

  let firstName = "";
  let lastName = "";
  if (name) {
    const parts = name.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length === 1) {
      firstName = parts[0];
    } else {
      lastName = parts[parts.length - 1];
      firstName = parts.slice(0, -1).join(" ");
    }
  }

  const dir = CATEGORY_DIRS[category];
  const dirAbs = path.join(ROOT, dir);
  fs.mkdirSync(dirAbs, { recursive: true });
  const usedFilenames = new Set(
    fs.readdirSync(dirAbs).map((f) => f.replace(/\.md$/, ""))
  );
  const filename = makeFilename(lastName, firstName, emails[0], usedFilenames);

  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const template = fs.readFileSync(TEMPLATE_PATH, "utf-8");
  const body = template.slice(template.indexOf("\n## Notes"));
  const content = `${buildFrontmatter(lastName, firstName, emails, today)}\n${body}`;

  const outPath = path.join(dirAbs, filename);
  fs.writeFileSync(outPath, content, "utf-8");
  console.log(`✍️  Created ${dir}/${filename}`);
}

main();
